chapter: Brass bands, funerals and Swedish scene
title: Trombonist Erwin Jones and a jam session with a Japanese drummer
summary: A new trombone player joins, and Edegran recalls a jam session with Rolf and the Japanese drummer.

story.theme_name: Trombonists: who they heard, admired and learned from
story.community_name: Talking trombonists: who played the slide and how

blocks.x: Well didn't they add another trombone later on?
Yeah, a fellow came in there, Shine or whatever they call it.
Yeah, Erwin Jones is real nice.
Yeah, he came in there and started playing. He sounds pretty good actually.
Yeah, he really disliked when we started playing this rasp and some soul man. So don't play that dead music. You want to play when the sings, you know.
Clive said he sounds like album one and he talks about J.J. Johnson.
Yeah, he likes that kind of his life. I played a jam session with him, Rolf and I, and the Japanese drummer who was here before.

Yeah. We played, had a session. Kimmy Rolf. Yeah, that's his name. We had a session together. That sounded not too bad. We played him well on some songs. But he actually, he don't know anything. I mean he don't know any tunes, he don't know anything about chords or nothing. He has feelings.
